title: Possession task
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Common vocabulary: personal pronouns, my family, adjectives and moods
source: Written for arabic/y7 lesson 6 (Pupil PDF worksheet: possession task)
intro: Lesson 6: My and your: endings and the possessive construct. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

panels.title: Two nouns: iḍāfah
points: First noun: no ال, no tanwin

head: Not this
This
rows: بَيْتُ جَدِّي: the first noun drops ال

box.title: Three of them in full sentences

keywords.def: possessive construct: two nouns together, 'X of Y'

questions.q: Possession task on the pupil PDF: write eight phrases (four with endings, four with iḍāfah) about your family's things, then use three in full sentences (e.g. سَيَّارَةُ أَبِي بَيْضَاءُ).
Extend: correct three wrong iḍāfah phrases.
questions.a: Drop ال and tanwin from the first noun
A) كِتَابُ أَخِي. Iḍāfah: no ال and no tanwin on the first noun.

questions.q: In iḍāfah the first noun has ...
Think again: 'the house of my grandfather' in two words?
